_doc: Reviewed, guarded uses of APIs Chrome 66 lacks (and CDN strings) in dist-panel. Each entry: api (the verifier's API label, or 'cdn:<host>'), chunkPattern (regex on the emitted file name) and/or contentPattern (regex the chunk content must contain, for hash-named chunks), and a one-line reason. Add an entry ONLY after reading the guarded use in the emitted chunk. 'seededFromCritique' entries were pre-seeded from the Phase 0 critique and still need that read once their chunk exists; the verifier lists unused entries as INFO.

entries.reason: i18next's built-in Formatter constructs Intl.RelativeTimeFormat lazily, only for `{{x, relativetime}}` interpolations; no panel string uses that formatter (read in the emitted entry chunk).
Same i18next Formatter: Intl.ListFormat (Chrome 72) is built only for `{{x, list}}` interpolations, which no panel string uses.

Excalidraw fork: every .roundRect( call is behind an `ctx.roundRect ? … : rect/strokeRect` ternary (read in the emitted whiteboard and shared collision chunks), and index.tsx:91 also imports canvas-roundrect-polyfill.
Excalidraw fork: polyfill.ts:26 installs Element.prototype.replaceChildren when missing; polyfill() runs at excalidraw index.tsx:23 import time, before any call (read in the emitted chunk).
pdfjs legacy build: `typeof crypto<"u"&&typeof crypto.randomUUID=="function"` guard with a getRandomValues fallback (read in PanelPdfViewer and pdf.worker chunks).
Excalidraw font loader's ASSETS_FALLBACK_URL constant; bundled fonts resolve to local ./assets URLs first, and the panel subset-main stub never walks the URL list for SVG export.

path2d-polyfill (pdfjs-dist 3.11 legacy): the only .roundRect( replays an 'RR' command recorded by its own Path2D polyfill, which installs only when Path2D is missing (Chrome 66 has Path2D) - read in the emitted chunk.
pdf.js FreeTextEditor (annotation editor) only; @react-pdf-viewer 3.12 never enables annotationEditorMode, so the panel PDF viewer never constructs it.

pdf.js main thread: the text-layer use is guarded by FeatureTest.isOffscreenCanvasSupported (typeof OffscreenCanvas); the rest are StampEditor / _isSVGFittingCanvas (annotation editor, never enabled). PanelPdfViewer passes isOffscreenCanvasSupported:false when OffscreenCanvas is missing.

pdf.js worker: evaluatorOptions.isOffscreenCanvasSupported &&= FeatureTest.isOffscreenCanvasSupported (legacy pdf.worker.js:5452); image decode/resize (44627-45046), FakeUnicodeFont (8965, 9963) and generateImages (7691) all check it; StampAnnotation.createImage is annotation saving only.

pica / image-blob-reduce feature-detect `typeof OffscreenCanvas>"u"` before use and the in-worker path runs only when that detection passed; loaded only by Excalidraw's image-insert resize, and image tools are off on panels.
@radix-ui/react-use-size guards `"borderBoxSize" in entry` and falls back to offsetWidth/offsetHeight (read in the emitted whiteboard chunk).
